subject: Krystle Campbell Softball Tournament Opening Ceremonies
overview: City officials and community members gathered for the opening ceremonies of the third annual softball tournament honoring Krystle Campbell and supporting her memorial scholarship fund.

items.title: Introduction of Guests
items.summary: Speaker 04 introduced local officials, school leadership, and representatives from the Boston Red Sox who gathered to support the memorial event.

items.title: Remarks by Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke
items.summary: Mayor Burke honored Krystle Campbell’s memory and praised the resilience of the community and neighboring towns.

items.title: Scholarship Fund Update
items.summary: The master of ceremonies reported that the tournament and merchandise sales have raised over $30,000 for a scholarship fund awarded annually to a graduating senior.

items.title: Student Tribute to Krystle Campbell
items.summary: Medford High School softball captain Gigi delivered a tribute honoring Campbell's legacy as an alumna and athlete while noting that the team has raised over $40,000 for the scholarship fund.

items.title: Remarks by Dr. Charles Steinberg
items.summary: Dr. Charles Steinberg of the Boston Red Sox spoke on the unifying power of diamond sports and their role in helping families and communities heal.

items.title: Presentations and Ceremonial Events
items.summary: Organizers presented commemorative shirts and softballs to the Campbell family and speakers before student Joanna Kubiak performed the National Anthem.
